steps.prompt: $? - 18 = 25$. Is the missing number bigger or smaller than $25$? Why?

cards.title: Which part is missing?
cards.body: A subtraction has a whole, a part taken away, and a part left. In $52 - ? = 37$ the part taken away is missing: $52 - 37 = 15$. In $? - 18 = 25$ the whole is missing: add the parts, $25 + 18 = 43$.

steps.text: The missing number is the whole. Add the two parts.

cards.title: The common trap
cards.body: In $? - 18 = 25$, some people work out $25 - 18 = 7$. Check: $7 - 18$ isn’t $25$. If the missing number comes first, it is the whole, so add.

prompts: How can you tell whether to add or subtract to find a missing number?
